    x, y = observation['self_position']

    opp = observation.get('opponent_position', None)
    obstacles = set(map(tuple, observation.get('obstacles', [])))

    def move_towards(tx, ty):
        dx = dy = 0
        if tx > x: dx = 1
        elif tx < x: dx = -1
        if ty > y: dy = 1
        elif ty < y: dy = -1
        return [dx, dy]

    def is_safe(nx, ny):
        return (0 <= nx < w and 0 <= ny < h and (nx, ny) not in obstacles)

    target = None

        dist = abs(rx - x) + abs(ry - y)
        if dist < min_dist:

            target = (rx, ry)
    if target:
        dx, dy = move_towards(*target)
        nx, ny = x + dx, y + dy
        if is_safe(nx, ny):
            return [dx, dy]

    # If no resources, pursue opponent if known
    if opp:
        ox, oy = opp
        dx, dy = move_towards(ox, oy)
        nx, ny = x + dx, y + dy
        if is_safe(nx, ny):
            return [dx, dy]

    # Else, attempt to move towards center
    center_x, center_y = w // 2, h // 2
    dx, dy = move_towards(center_x, center_y)
    nx, ny = x + dx, y + dy
    if is_safe(nx, ny):
        return [dx, dy]

    # Otherwise, stay in place
    return [0, 0]
